text:
Eli: quick flag  a support ledger shows a tiny but consistent billing delta after yesterday's routing change. looks like reconnects are sometimes producing two very short sessions in the console.
Saira: saw a few tickets too. is this specific to SSE or spread to WS?
Eli: mostly SSE, some WS multiplexed clients. i grabbed a short trace: tr-7f1b. pattern: client sends normal close, proxy accepts, client reconnects immediately and lands on new route; billing logs show two charge-starts ~250ms apart.
Tom: can you paste logs?
Eli: ```
[proxy] 2026-04-01T14:02:11Z route-claim cid=usr-9 ttl=80ms shard=eu-central
[proxy] 2026-04-01T14:02:11.120 client-close cid=usr-9 code=1000
[client] 2026-04-01T14:02:11.130 reconnect cid=usr-9 new_shard=eu-west
[billing] 2026-04-01T14:02:11.145 charge-start session=usr-9
[billing] 2026-04-01T14:02:11.410 charge-start session=usr-9.2
```
Saira: billing triggers on route claim so overlap shows as two active sessions. console dedupe uses Last-Event-ID but many SSE reconnecting clients don't send it.
Tom: could this be the affinity TTL change from yesterday? we tightened splay to speed rebalancing. that would make tombstones expire faster and increase chance of a new claim before old drains.
Eli: exactly. i repro'd locally by shortening affinity and doing immediate reconnects; overlap windows were ~200-500ms.
infra-billing: note: billing team charges on claim to guarantee prompt capacity accounting. switching to first-byte would delay attribution and complicate failed-handshakes.
Saira: short-term options: (A) roll back affinity splay, (B) add a small idempotency window in billing keyed by client fingerprint, (C) change console to hide overlaps <500ms and label as "route-swap".
Tom: fingerprinting might be reasonable: hash(client-id + ip-range + ua) as a heuristic. downside: NAT/CF proxies could cause false positives.
Eli: agree. also consider a hybrid: billing dedupe only if Last-Event-ID matches OR fingerprint matches and overlap <1s. reduces false positives.
Saira: telemetry ask: add metric "route_claim_overlap_rate" and a histogram of overlap durations; surface top-k fingerprints and traces. console should link to trace timeline when overlap annotated.
infra-billing: longer-term RFC accepted: BILL-412 propose idempotent charging with configurable window and optional first-byte fallback for handshakes that fail. we'll prototype on staging.
ops-bot: canary rollback suggested by Saira at 14:20 UTC.
Tom: for immediate mitigation i'll create CANARY revert for affinity splay. Saira can you open a quick console UI tweak to hide sub-second overlaps and show "likely route swap" tooltip?
Saira: will do. also ping sdks@ about encouraging SSE clients to send Last-Event-ID on reconnects; that would make dedupe deterministic.
Eli: thanks. i'll file a short postmortem and include testcases in the streaming harness to catch overlaps >0.2%.
Tom: let's reconvene after rollback results and the staged billing prototype.
